$comment: Operation-level allowlist for every DurisWeb write to a MUD-owned table. `pnpm verify:mud-writes` scans non-test backend sources and fails when a write is unclassified or when an entry no longer matches any statement, so no cross-boundary mutation reaches review unclassified. See docs/ongoing-projects/ongoing.md, DB-10.

baseline.note: `mudOwnedTables` is a verbatim copy of that manifest's `required_tables`. Refresh both fields together when the MUD publishes a new baseline.

routes/admin.ts|UPDATE|ip_info.authoritativeWriter: MUD connection logging writes the rows; DurisWeb only closes rows the MUD abandoned.
routes/admin.ts|UPDATE|ip_info.concurrency: Bounded to sessions connected over an hour ago with no recorded disconnect, so it cannot race a live session row.

routes/admin.ts|UPDATE|level_cap.authoritativeWriter: DurisWeb administration owns this single-row global configuration; the MUD reads it.
routes/admin.ts|UPDATE|level_cap.concurrency: Single row, Overlord-only, last write wins. No ledger or per-player state depends on the previous value.

routes/admin.ts|UPDATE|timers.authoritativeWriter: DurisWeb administration resets named global event timers; the MUD reads and advances them.
routes/admin.ts|UPDATE|timers.concurrency: Idempotent reset to `UNIX_TIMESTAMP()` on named rows, Overlord-only. A concurrent MUD advance is superseded, which is the intended operator action.
routes/admin.ts|UPDATE|timers.note: The MUD owner has not confirmed whether an in-flight timer event can observe the reset mid-tick.

services/mudAuctionClient.ts|UPDATE|acco.authoritativeWriter: MUD character deletion; DurisWeb only records the soft delete after the MUD command has been confirmed.
services/mudAuctionClient.ts|UPDATE|acco.concurrency: Guarded by `deleted_at IS NULL`, so a repeated or concurrent confirmation is a no-op and cannot resurrect a row.

services/pvpService.ts|UPDATE|pkill_even.authoritativeWriter: MUD PvP recording owns the event row; DurisWeb maintains only the denormalized like and comment counters.
services/pvpService.ts|UPDATE|pkill_even.concurrency: Counter change is applied in the same InnoDB transaction as the web-owned interaction row, so the pair cannot diverge on failure.
services/pvpService.ts|UPDATE|pkill_even.note: DB-04 removed the session `sql_mode` override. The counters should move to the web-owned tables or a reconciled projection once the MUD normalizes `pkill_event.stamp`.

services/statisticsParser.ts|INSERT INTO.authoritativeWriter: DurisWeb ingestion owns this time series, parsed from the MUD statistics feed.
services/statisticsParser.ts|INSERT INTO.concurrency: Append-only rows keyed by parsed hour; re-parsing the same source hour is the only overlap and is operator-initiated.
services/statisticsParser.ts|INSERT INTO.note: DB-11 adds `statistics(date)` through the MUD schema owner; this write path is unaffected by that index.

services/zoneService.ts|UPDATE|zones.authoritativeWriter: DurisWeb builder tooling owns the zone metadata columns it edits; the MUD reads zone data.
services/zoneService.ts|UPDATE|zones.concurrency: Authenticated builder edits keyed by zone `number`, restricted to the columns the request supplies.
services/zoneService.ts|UPDATE|zones.note: The MUD owner has not confirmed whether a running MUD rereads these columns without a reboot.
